description: Canonical Decision Trace flow metadata and reference templates for common audit scenarios.

steps.label: External Sources
steps.summary: Market intelligence, news feeds, regulatory filings, or any non-proprietary data leveraged during the audit.

steps.label: Internal Sources
steps.summary: Proprietary research, portfolio documents, or internal knowledge bases referenced for the analysis.

steps.label: Tooling Call
steps.summary: Execution or analytics tools that were invoked (risk engines, optimizers, scenario generators, etc.).

steps.label: AI Agent Call
steps.summary: Autonomous agent participation or hand-offs between orchestrated AI agents.

steps.label: LLM Interaction
steps.summary: Large language model prompt/response exchange that provided reasoning or narrative steps.

steps.label: RAG (Context Enhancement)
steps.summary: Retrieval-augmented context generation, blending sources that informed the LLM.

steps.label: Response Generation
steps.summary: Final synthesized response, recommendation, or action emitted by the workflow.

templates.label: Summary Generation
templates.description: Used for narrative briefings such as Morning Portfolio Briefing and other summarization use cases.

templates.label: Analytics
templates.description: Used for analytical dashboards like Risk Alerts, Today's Actions, and Performance Metrics.

loopPatterns.description: Iterative analytic refinement using tooling and LLM review.

templates.label: Agentic Analytics
templates.description: Applies to Thesis Decay sub-sections and Bias Sentinel analysis where agent collaboration is involved.

loopPatterns.description: Agent delegates repeated tooling probes before final synthesis.
LLM self-correct loop with augmented context.
